newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's PRISCO sees no 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: Russia's PRISCO sees no 1996 loss.

text.p: Russian shipping company PRISCO revised upwards its expected performance in 1996, saying it planned to close 1996 without making a loss.

AOOT Primorskoye Morskoye Parokhodstvo vice-president Yevgeny Kozmin told Reuters the company's losses in the first nine months of 1996 were lower than planned and two billion roubles lower than in the first half-year.
PRISCO had a first-half pre-tax loss of 10 billion roubles, compared with one billion in the same period of 1995.
Kozmin also said PRISCO planned to pay a dividend for 1996 but gave no details.
Shareholders voted through a dividend for 1995 of 1,090 percent per 20 rouble share.
Pre-tax profit in 1995 was 115.22 billion roubles.
Kozmin said this year's losses were partly explained by the introduction of a new accounting system, under which income was booked at the end of each voyage rather than when cash was received.
Kozmin said the volume of coastal traffic had diminished this year though international and charter traffic had increased.
